hold_text: Adds a VERIFIED hold_reason `unvouchable_paths` to scripts/ci/check_pr_landing.py, so a human should read the change to the landing route before it lands. R5's own remedy text says 'Either narrow the PR, or set landing: hold and let a human read it' -- and no hold_reason said that, so every other value would have been a false statement. Found because this PR edits scripts/check_provenance_consumers.py and scripts/check_strategy_coverage.py: 26 CI guard scripts live in bare scripts/ while their sibling scripts/ci/** is allowlisted, and no truthful declaration existed for any of them. The new reason grants nothing -- it does not widen TIER1_SURFACE, it is a hold, and R14 verifies it against the diff so a PR whose paths are all inside the allowlist cannot claim it.
why: CI tooling and its tests. Adds scripts/ci/check_guard_selftest_coverage.py plus its exemption file, adds planted-failure --self-test controls to four guard scripts and wires them (plus check_lever_wiring.py's existing but uninvoked one) into run_guards.py, adds tests/test_guard_selftest_coverage.py, adds a verified hold_reason to check_pr_landing.py, corrects a refuted finding in the 2026-09-09 audit doc, and files three backlog rows. NO src/, NO config/, NO deploy/, NO .github/workflows/, no order path, no strategy params, no risk caps, no live-VM file. Tier-1 by the canonical doc's own examples (docs, tests, CI, tooling); held for a human read only because it touches the landing route.
